components.description: UMD campus policy II-2.25(A): up to eight work weeks of paid Parental Leave to care for a new child, charged first to the faculty member's accrued annual, sick, personal or collegial leave and supplemented by University-funded Assured Parental Leave to reach eight work weeks; no duties required during the leave.
components.mechanism_note: R1c: the University guarantees the eight-week paid period whatever the balance (balances first, then Assured Parental Leave); a dedicated parent leave, not a sick plan (V1 last sentence).
components.faculty_group_note: all full-time and part-time tenured and tenure-track faculty, professional track faculty, and all librarian faculty, with appointments of at least 50% FTE
components.eligible_parent_wording: The birth of a newborn; The placement of a child for adoption or foster care under the age of six (6)
components.caregiver_condition_wording: At the time a faculty member takes Parental Leave, they should be acting as primary caregiver.
components.service_requirement: one semester (instructional faculty); six months (non-instructional); appointment of at least 50% FTE
components.dual_employee_rule: both may be eligible up to the eight work week maximum; Assured Parental Leave may only be used by one parent on a given workday
components.entitlement_note: 'shall be assured'; the request form and two months' notice are arrangements.
components.medical_certification_note: Use of Parental Leave does not require medical documentation or proof of placement.
components.duration_note: eight work weeks (forty work days); must be taken continuously (FAQ); prorated for part-time faculty.
components.relief_note: Stated: no institutional work-related duties are required while on Parental Leave.

sequence.note: R3b: instructional faculty are released for the semester in which the leave is taken (the remaining weeks of the semester after the leave).

components.time_window: beginning six months before and up to twelve months after the birth or placement; an adopted or foster child under the age of six
components.use_limit_note: one occasion in a given 12-month period, and three occasions during employment with USM; additional periods require the President's approval. The FAQ (2018_09, and its copy in 2018_10) says two occasions; the governing policy (amended 2016) decides.
components.notice: at least two months in advance of the expected leave

components.description: USM II-2.31 implements the federal FMLA for faculty: up to 12 workweeks (60 days) of unpaid, job-protected leave per calendar year for the birth of a child, placement for adoption or foster care, care of the child within 12 months, care of an immediate family member, or the faculty member's own serious health condition. Paid Parental Leave runs concurrently with it.

notes: 2018_00_link is a University of Maryland, Baltimore (UMB) Academic Affairs page summarising the USM parental leave policy for UMB faculty (its own policy IIK2.25, not saved); it is another campus and holds no College Park policy. Nothing coded from it; the system policy it describes is coded from 2018_01 (c2).

Which policy: the campus policy UMD II-2.25(A) (amended 2016-10-07) and the system policy USM II-2.25 (2012) give the same eight-week paid parental leave; both coded and linked concurrent_with (V3c). The campus policy is more generous (one semester of service instead of one year; three uses instead of two; an 18-month window).

Paid Parental Leave (c1) is charged first to accrued annual, sick, personal and collegial leave, then to University-funded Assured Parental Leave, so the University guarantees the full eight work weeks (R1c; the rule's own example). The components for those balances (c8, c9, c11) are linked within c1.

The USM Family Support Plan (II-2.25 III) and the UMD Plan Content (III.B) list leave (balances, paid parental leave, collegial leave, unpaid FMLA leave up to 12 weeks) and workload modifications (part-time, spreading or redistributing teaching). Those are coded as c1/c2/c7/c9 (leave), c5 (part-time) and c6 (rearrangement, R16). The UMD campus policy III.C.1 adds the entitlement to a semester's release from classroom teaching and service for instructional faculty (c3).

Unpaid leave within the plan is bounded by 'the twelve (12) week (i.e., sixty (60) work day) limit' of the FMLA policy; with Parental Leave counted against F&M leave this is the FMLA envelope itself (c7 concurrent_with c1), so no separate leave_limits entry was recorded.

The F&M leave entitlement is per calendar year under USM II-2.31 (the statute: any 12-month period). F&M leave for school vacations of a child under 14 is not usable for a birth and is not a component. The USM policy's temporary reassignment to an alternative position during intermittent leave is an employer option, not a benefit; not coded.

USM II-2.30 III.B.6: when accrued sick leave is exhausted the faculty member is removed from salaried status (with FMLA and ADA requirements), and the institution helps evaluate modified duty, disability retirement or disability insurance: no leave or plan with terms is granted, so no component (no long-term disability plan is described in the sources).
Calendar: the policy speaks of an 'academic semester' and 'one semester' release without stating its length; calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Documents named but not saved: UMD II-2.31(A) University Faculty Family Medical Leave Act Policy; USM Policy on Leave Without Pay for Faculty; UMCP Guidelines and Procedures for Faculty Leave of Absence Without Pay; UMB faculty parental leave policy IIK2.25; USM Policies 1.05 and 1.06 (faculty definitions); USM II-1.00 on Appointment, Rank and Tenure; UMD II-4.00(A) faculty grievances; UMD Policy on Professional Leave for Librarians; UMD Policy and Procedures on Sabbatical Leave for Faculty; UMD Policy on Transitional Terminal Leave; Frequently Asked Questions about Tenure Delay; Faculty Parental Leave Request form; Notification of Delay of Mandatory Tenure Review form.
Sabbatical, professional leave for librarians, transitional terminal leave, bereavement use of sick leave and jury duty are described but cannot be used for a birth; not components.

Conflict: the Paid Parental Leave FAQ (2018_09, copied in 2018_10) states two uses during USM employment (the USM 2012 figure), while UMD II-2.25(A) (amended 2016) states three, as does the FML FAQ in 2018_10; the governing campus policy is coded (c1) and the conflict flagged.

Chain, birth parent: Parental Leave 8 workweeks (balances, then Assured Parental Leave) within the semester of teaching and service release (c3, R3b); F&M leave (12 workweeks) concurrent from the start of the Parental Leave, leaving four unpaid weeks after it; USM minimum leave (c2) concurrent with c1; collegial and accrued sick leave lie within c1.

Chain, non-birth parent (as primary caregiver): Parental Leave 8 workweeks within the semester of teaching and service release (c3); F&M leave concurrent from its start. Both UMD parents may take Parental Leave and the plan, sequentially; Assured Parental Leave only one parent per day.
